# Radoslav Radev Requires Minimum 10 Seconds on Tuck Planche Before Advancing to Advanced Planche

Radoslav Radev requires that before going from tuck planche to advanced planche, you have minimum 10 seconds with good form and good technique. [src: vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 01:46]

## Details

- Before going from tuck planche to advanced planche, make sure you have minimum 10 seconds with good form and good technique, and then you are ready to go to advanced. [src: vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 01:46]
- If you have 10 seconds you are ready, but not if you have two seconds. [src: vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 02:00]
- Do not wait too long on a progression because you will waste a lot of time. [src: vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 01:56]

## Evidence

- vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 01:46 (Radoslav Radev): "let's say you are on tuck planche before you go to advanced planche make sure that you have minimum 10 seconds with good form good technique and then you're ready to go to advance"
- vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 02:00 (Radoslav Radev): "so if you have 10 seconds you're ready but not if you have two seconds"

## Why This Matters

He says that skipping levels and not controlling the basics is how people get hurt. [src: vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 01:40]

## Connected Ideas

- [[Radoslav Radev Requires Minimum 15 Pull-Ups, 20 Dips, and 30 Push-Ups Before Attempting Planche, Front Lever, Handstand, or Handstand Push-Ups]] — the foundation requirement before starting skill work.
